officialSources.observation: Israel Mapping Center parcel layer; public ArcGIS REST FeatureServer, CRS EPSG:2039 (ITM), polygon geometry, anonymous query support.

requests.outcome: CloudFront request blocked; no login, CAPTCHA bypass, or TLS exception attempted. This is not evidence of parcel absence.
Municipal page was found in first-party discovery and described by indexed content, but direct fetch was forbidden.
Inspected layer schema and extent. Native safe identity fields include PARCEL_ID, GUSH_NUM, PARCEL and GushHelka; service CRS is EPSG:2039. Unsafe owner/address fields were not requested.

Anonymous bounded intersects query over ITM envelope 198850,643094,202850,647094, with outSR=4326 and resultRecordCount=3, returned three Polygon features associated with locality Modiin-Maccabim-Reut. Exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted; the request was a map-extent sample, not an exact-point absence test. Full unchanged response is in ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/modiin/query.geojson.
